description: This file defines the Perl package 'Git::SVN::GlobSpec' which provides functionality to parse, validate, and generate regular expressions for glob patterns used in file path matching. It includes methods for constructing pattern objects and computing full file paths based on glob patterns.

classes.name: Git::SVN::GlobSpec
classes.description: A class representing a glob pattern specification, providing methods to process patterns and generate regexes for matching file paths.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor method to create a new GlobSpec object; it processes the glob pattern, validates it, and compiles a regex for matching file paths.

methods.name: full_path
methods.description: Method to generate a full file path by incorporating the left and right components of the pattern with a given relative path.
